response.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM a) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM a CROSS JOIN o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: An album's average bytes per millisecond is the mean of each track's Bytes/Milliseconds ratio, with tracks with NULL Bytes ignored. Tracks with NULL AlbumId form one group via GROUP BY.

The all-album average is the unweighted mean of the per-album averages, so each album counts equally regardless of its track count. The difference is the album's average minus that mean. Albums with no computable rate (all Bytes NULL) are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Album rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds (a duration-weighted ratio) over tracks that have Bytes, and the all-album average is the mean of those album rates.
alternatives.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM a) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM a CROSS JOIN o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
